assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.

Given the history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities.
Mobile cardiac telemetry service corresponds to CPT code 93229.
The service supports the documented diagnosis code I48.91.
The service supports the documented diagnosis code I49.5.
The indication note confirms the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
